result.brief: 提出 UltraWorld，通过自蒸馏将临床超声视频中的视频基础模型先验迁移为可交互世界模型，并用声学采样图（AsMap）编码探头位姿与成像参数，实现无需动作标注的动作条件未来观测预测。
result.reason: Self-distills a video foundation model into an interactive ultrasound world model predicting future observations from actions; introduces Acoustic Sampling Map pose representation. Primary world-model contribution, application to ultrasound scanning.
